original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.

actual_scope: Independent exact-arithmetic audit of one implication of the newest composed conditional supplier: PR #3653's published T488 x retiming paid profile equals PR #3642's published ideal fixed-capacity packing profile at T=488 exactly, PROFILE_488 = 4392*local_bill + 488*ideal_idle_per_replica. Checks: reproduce the certificate's own T740 ideal as a convention control; the exact identity; aggregate identities (rank mass 65088*488, live 896*488, physical 437757); the residual decomposition; capacity feasibility; the moment bracket at the two published 10^-24 endpoints with an 80-digit engine; the released 70-digit string; the delta over the pinned T530 floor against the published headroom; seven rejection controls. Consequence stated only at certificate strength: the composition is the optimal vertex of the cited relaxation, so the 2.4507952107748684e-8 T530-to-T488 root headroom is closed exactly and no repacking inside that model can improve it. No word, owner journal, native provider, admission stage or selected-frontier value is replayed; no new kappa is claimed.
scope_change_reason: The card's named first object is a #2979 joint rank-7 audit. This session instead closes a stated open question from the immediately preceding independent audit of the same live frontier family (PR #3740, open question 2: is the composed profile's moment margin zero against PR #3642's relaxation?). That is a direct, bounded continuation of the same claimed supplier, and the answer is an exact identity rather than another report of near-equal decimals. The card's acceptance gate - independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls - is met by the seven controls and the exact reconstruction.

Deciding whether its current value is a word-level advance or the certified packing ceiling determines where the next unit of effort goes: more repacking (exhausted) versus a changed word, bill, inventory or model.

open_questions.question: Can the 2,551-pattern dual be re-derived independently of PR #3642's script?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The attainment conclusion inherits the certificate's optimality. A separate implementation would turn a re-executed receipt into an independent proof of optimality.
open_questions.first_step: Rebuild PR3630's 10x10 basis spec and the residual-rank objective from the published constants, then check every pattern's reduced cost with exact rational interval arithmetic.
open_questions.blocked_by: The certificate's coefficient convention (a 73x scaling of the binomial moment) must be matched first; this package treats it as quoted.

open_questions.question: Does a changed helper inventory or capacity row move the optimal vertex?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Bill additivity keeps the vertex fixed for any additive bill, so the remaining lever is the inventory. If a changed capacity row lowers the root, the family has a real next search; if not, only the word/model remains.
open_questions.first_step: Recompute the primal idle vertex under one changed capacity row, then evaluate the resulting root with the same bracket method.
open_questions.blocked_by: Requires the dual re-derivation above or a trusted certificate variant for the changed row.

open_questions.why_it_matters: The certificate bounds a fractional packing; physical-family and chronology attainment are separate obligations and a gap there would weaken the attained-cap reading.
